description: The floating summary card at the top of the Savings screen. Aggregates every goal into one headline: total saved, total target, overall percent, and count chips (goals / funded / behind). The ONLY card on the screen that floats and uses h1 — mirrors the dashboard StatusHeadlineCard's role.

behindCount.description: goals with a genuinely at-risk deadline

loading.description: renders Skeleton placeholders in the same layout

accessibility.label: Overall progress, {fmt(totalCurrent)} saved of {fmt(totalTarget)}, {overallPercent} percent. {goalCount} goals, {fundedCount} funded, {behindCount} behind.
accessibility.note: Count chips pair icon + number + word so they are color-independent.

developerNotes: Reuse the totals already computed in savings.tsx (totalCurrent/totalTarget/overallPercent). Only fundedCount/behindCount are new — derive from getGoalStatus. Keep visible in the zero/empty state showing $0 / $0 so the screen has an anchor. This is the only card using glassFloating + h1.
